title: StarCraft: Brood War Patch 1.18 Patch Notes
summary: The original StarCraft is now free for everyone with the release of this latest patch.

title: Remastering StarCraft's Art
summary: Blizzard’s Classic Games team had a very specific vision for the art direction of StarCraft: Remastered. The guiding principle? Stay true to the original.

title: Rock and Roll Days of StarCraft: a Development Retrospective
summary: They didn’t know it yet, but the sci-fi game they were building, one wild improvisation at a time, would become a landmark in the real-time strategy genre and a fixture of global esports. The name of the game was StarCraft.

title: The Sounds of Koprulu
summary: Sound is a delicate thing. It bypasses language barriers and affects us at a subliminal level. It doesn’t do those things very well in the vacuum of space—but the Koprulu sector’s a noisy corner of the galaxy.

title: Behind the Scenes of StarCraft: Remastered
summary: The StarCraft: Remastered team is small, nimble, and intensely passionate about their source material.

title: Feature Preview: Hotkeys
summary: The first implementation of Hotkeys in StarCraft: Remastered during the early 1.18 Public Test Realm (PTR) drew a lot of great feedback and discussion. The Classic Games team took the community’s input to heart, and today we’re excited to unveil the version of Hotkeys you can expect when StarCraft: Remastered comes out this summer.

title: Feature Preview: Profiles
summary: Another exciting new feature in StarCraft: Remastered is making its debut. Profiles will be home to multiplayer statistics, replays, ladder ranks (for the new matchmaking system), and more!

title: Tasteless and Artosis on 19 Years of StarCraft (And Counting)
summary: As StarCraft: Remastered’s summer release approaches, nobody is more excited than Nick ‘Tasteless’ Plott and Dan ‘Artosis’ Stemkoski. We caught up with this world-renowned shoutcasting duo to discuss what StarCraft means to them—and what it means to see the game remastered for the modern age.

title: Feature Preview: Leaderboard
summary: It’s not just StarCraft’s graphics that are receiving an overhaul this summer—StarCraft: Remastered will also add modern matchmaking and ladder functionality, including a shiny new Leaderboard! At launch, StarCraft: Remastered will include leaderboards for Friends and IGRs.

title: Feature Preview: Chat
summary: Chat Channels have been a core part of the StarCraft experience since 1998, and starting this summer, we’re making them even better! StarCraft: Remastered will allow you to access multiple Chat Channels—from more places throughout the game—without changing the classic functionality that you know and love.

title: Unit Spotlight: Zerg
summary: The Zerg are innumerable, merciless, and free of fear. A tide of teeth and spines, they pour across the universe, devouring everything in their path. In StarCraft: Remastered, view the galaxy’s most ferocious creatures in spitting, slavering HD.

title: Unit Spotlight: Terran
summary: Terrans are the scrappy improvisers of StarCraft, relying on cobbled-together technology and a resilient spirit...

title: Unit Spotlight: Protoss
summary: Sophisticated psionic biology. Gilded technology that defies the laws of space and time. If the Protoss are arrogant, as their detractors claim, can you blame them? They were cruising the galaxy in golden superships when humans were still digging in the dirt for grubs.

title: From StarCraft Pro Gamer to a Seat at Blizzard: TheBOy Interview
summary: With StarCraft: Remastered launching on August 14, it’s never been a more appropriate time to look back on almost two decades of StarCraft history. This week we shine a spotlight on Kook ‘TheBOy’ Kibong, who was 18 years old when StarCraft came out. He soon became one of the best players in Korea, placing highly in numerous tournaments. Years later, he found himself at Blizzard Korea, where he currently helps manage StarCraft and StarCraft II esports.

title: Map Spotlight: The Lost Temple
summary: The Lost Temple has been found. Can you be the one to destroy your opponents and secure it?

title: StarCraft: Remastered Portrait Contest
summary: Check out the official StarCraft: Remastered fan art contest for portraits!

title: Spotlight: Pre-Purchase Rewards
summary: StarCraft: Remastered launches on August 14, but if you reserve your copy ahead of time, you’ll receive bountiful rewards, including the infested terran co-op commander Alexei Stukov and three unique portraits in StarCraft II. You’ll also receive three building skins in StarCraft: Remastered. Read on for a look into these stunning in-game rewards!

title: Story Interludes: A New Look at the First War
summary: Just as we’re enhancing StarCraft’s visuals to bring out the character of each unit, we want to give a similar boost to how we tell parts of the story in StarCraft: Remastered, adjusting how we present them while keeping the tale you know intact.

title: Which race should I play?
summary: Each of StarCraft’s three unique races brings different units, buildings, core mechanics, and personalities to the battlefield. That doesn’t mean you can only play one—but it does make “Which race should I play?” a question worthy of careful consideration.

title: StarCraft: Remastered Launch Event
summary: Get ready for the StarCraft: Remastered Launch Event, starting on Monday!

title: StarCraft: Remastered Is Live
summary: The real-time strategy game that started a legacy is back. Jump in and relive the rush.

title: StarCraft: Remastered Portrait Contest Finalists
summary: We've selected 28 of the best portraits we received and present them to you for voting!

title: The astronaut who brought StarCraft into space
summary: We recently sat down for a conversation with Daniel Barry, the former astronaut who in 1999 flew a StarCraft game disc into space aboard the Space Shuttle Discovery.

title: Can Jaedong Beat Bisu in the Ultimate Title Fight?
summary: StarCraft legend Lee Jae Dong seeks redemption in the Ultimate Title Fight at BlizzCon on Friday at 6:45 p.m. PDT.

title: Patch 1.21.0 – The Return of EUD Maps
summary: You asked for it, and we listened: We’re adding support for EUD maps to bring back some of your favorite custom games.

title: Patch 1.22.0 – New Ranking System and Rewards
summary: Today, we’d like to preview the new system and give you some additional information about how we’re improving player profiles.
